step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify services from the visual whiteboard and transcript: Kinesis (KinesisDataStream and Firehose icons inside the Kinesis box), a daisy-chained processing unit containing Lambda and DynamoDB (for parse, enrich, normalize stages), auxiliary Lambda (Lambda (n)), Aurora Serverless, OpenSearch (Elasticsearch), AWS Glue, S3, and Athena.
2. Decompose grouped boxes: The Kinesis box contains Kinesis Data Streams and Kinesis Data Firehose icons. The processing block contains Lambda and DynamoDB.
3. Trace arrow connections:
   - Ingestion: Kinesis Data Stream feeds into the processing Lambda. Kinesis Data Firehose feeds directly to S3.
   - Stage processing: Processing Lambda writes to DynamoDB.
   - Streaming triggers: DynamoDB Streams feed into auxiliary Lambda (n).
   - Auxiliary outputs: Lambda (n) writes to Aurora Serverless and OpenSearch (Elasticsearch).
   - Data Lake / Analytics: AWS Glue processes data in S3; Athena queries data directly in S3.
4. Assign sequential flow IDs and format into valid JSON matching the Cloudscape dataset schema.

graph.name: HP - Real-Time Manufacturing Data Pipeline
graph.notes: HP's real-time data pipeline for ink cartridge manufacturing data using Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB streams, Aurora Serverless, Elasticsearch, S3, Glue, and Athena.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.notes: Persists raw streaming data directly into S3

nodes.name: Processing Lambda
nodes.notes: Daisy-chained Lambda processing stage for parsing, enriching, and normalizing data

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores intermediate stage data and triggers subsequent Lambdas via DynamoDB Streams

nodes.name: Auxiliary Lambda (n)
nodes.notes: Processes DynamoDB Streams to persist data to secondary data stores

nodes.name: Aurora Serverless
nodes.notes: Relational data store queried via Data API for SQL users

nodes.name: Elasticsearch
nodes.notes: Provides real-time dashboards for tracking parts in manufacturing lifecycle

nodes.name: AWS Glue
nodes.notes: Scheduled ETL jobs for bulk processing data in S3

nodes.name: S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Central data lake for raw and processed manufacturing data

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Interactive SQL query service over S3 data lake
